title: What If Russia Fought Pluto?
description:
Russia versus Pluto: which one is bigger? Russia is the largest country on Earth at about 17.1 million square kilometers. Pluto's whole surface is about 17.7 million, slightly bigger than Russia (by about 4%). On population, Russia has about 146 million people and Pluto has none, so it's a tie.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'Pluto' (surface area 1.774e7 km²) and 'Russia' (area 17,098,246 km²; population estimate 146 million). The seesaw and referee are illustrations.

What should we put on the seesaw next? Tell us in the comments.
